notes.note: Fix round 6 of the delivery-state change: a remote-change pass starts only when a row the previous projection showed held back by an earlier row of its chat becomes sendable here (no longer on every notice, which re-sent a busy chat's message until it failed); that pass only sends (no reconcile, no syncHeld); a durable replay into a running turn returns deferred instead of not-invoked, so it spends no attempt (useActiveChatSessionMessaging.ts); a renderer whose lock request fails is recorded in a bounded localStorage list and read as unknown liveness, never gone (outboundQueueLease.ts); claimNext marks its claim in flight before announcing it. Rewrote the Behavior paragraph's remote-pass sentence: a projection starts a send-only pass (no reconcile, no syncHeld) only when a row it showed held back by an earlier row of its chat (claimNext's rule) is now sendable here; added that a replay into a running turn is deferred and spends no attempt, and that a renderer whose lock request failed reads as unknown. Checked against keysBlockedByEarlierRows, sendableHere and the send-only mode in useOutboundQueueFlush.ts, the busy branch in useActiveChatSessionMessaging.ts, outboundQueueLease.ts, and their tests.
